I'm not great with names so I don't remember who I have unfortunately.

My counsellor advised me to call in and change to a different GP, which I will make sure to do soon, as their complete lack of understanding, education and empathy is absolutely ridiculous, especially since this should be the one person I should absolutely be able to go to for things like this.

Because my GP is incredibly unprofessional, I can't get a proper diagnosis (although no doubt I have it, I've tried for so long to ignore it, but I've had no luck), which means I can't get proper treatment or support.

This happened over the phone a couple weeks ago while I was at counselling. The only reason I haven't spoke up about it sooner, is because I haven't been able to find an email to contact (and I'm a little awkward over the phone).

I'm writing this to warn anyone who is going through a struggle similar to mine.",null,[0,233]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmamZ6NG9BRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x7f467270cc4866c1!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDfjfz4oAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmamZ6NG9BRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmamZ6NG9BRRIsChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmamZ6NFlBEhJDZ3NJbjRQOXV3WVFzTFB5R0EaLQoXQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lEZmpmejQ0QUUSEkNnc0luNFA5dXdZUXNMUHlHQSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEcFmSMxwckZ_KhJDZ3NJbjRQOXV3WVFzTFB5R0E&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwinoZePnK-TAxVkAXsEHRLENU8QoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwinoZePnK-TAxVkAXsEHRLENU8Q0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSM1V5TlRaeGVsOWZSV2hCUkc5eU1IZGxZME5aZWpjM2RWaHlNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSWjBOaE4ySnVjWEpOV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURPcnJ6OG53RRAB",["0x0:0x7f467270cc4866c1",null,1657042043207720,1657042043207720,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109844104930702961170/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["anthony burns","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLB6B1GxpvJedt5StFAmyTndJkLu16LoJcebuJcTlGUWNiuAQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109844104930702961170?hl=en"],"109844104930702961170",null,7,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["7 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwinoZePnK-TAxVkAXsEHRLENU8Q7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"3 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I only registered with the surgery in December 2021 and anytime I have been to the surgery has been professional and caring.

Everyone’s view is personal and my own experience from Dr Corrigan and Dr Kidds compassion and thoughtfulness is beyond words.

I thank them both from the bottom of my heart for the phone calls they make to ask me how I am and what if anything they can do for me.
They won’t realise how uplifting this makes me feel and how much it has helped me since my diagnosis.
My journey with my illness has only just begun but i know I have their support if I need it and that is some  of the best medicine I have

Thank you all

Anthony
